scripts.db:migrate: npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate --env auth --migrations-path apps/auth/migrations && npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate --env employee --migrations-path apps/employee/migrations && npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate --env attendance --migrations-path apps/attendance/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:status: npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate:status --env auth --migrations-path apps/auth/migrations && npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate:status --env employee --migrations-path apps/employee/migrations && npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate:status --env attendance --migrations-path apps/attendance/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:undo:auth: npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate:undo --env auth --migrations-path apps/auth/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:undo:employee: npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate:undo --env employee --migrations-path apps/employee/migrations
scripts.db:migrate:undo:attendance: npm run -s sequelize -- db:migrate:undo --env attendance --migrations-path apps/attendance/migrations
scripts.db:seed: npm run -s sequelize -- db:seed:all --env employee --seeders-path apps/employee/seeders && npm run -s sequelize -- db:seed:all --env auth --seeders-path apps/auth/seeders
scripts.db:seed:undo: npm run -s sequelize -- db:seed:undo:all --env auth --seeders-path apps/auth/seeders && npm run -s sequelize -- db:seed:undo:all --env employee --seeders-path apps/employee/seeders
